title: festuca paniculata var. livida
intro: Festuca paniculata var. livida, commonly known as the green tuft grass, is a species of grass in the family Poaceae. It is a perennial plant that is native to China and is traditionally used in medicine for its health benefits. The health benefits of Festuca paniculata var. livida include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
